notes:
Fix a line and it stays fixed.

Tap the caption strip while read-along is running and you can rewrite what it says. Your wording is kept for that page and never overwritten — not when the page is read again, not by a future update.

Useful for names above all. The text reader gets character names wrong in ways no automatic spellcheck can fix without mangling the ones it got right, so now you can just tell it.

Also: a few more words the reader turned into numbers are read as words again.
